description: Add detectarIntencionLocal(texto) function that intercepts voice commands before sending to Cloud Function. Resolves navigation, modal opening, and confirmation commands instantly on the frontend.
steps: STEP 1: Add extended ALIAS_VISTAS entries for new aliases: despachos/salidas=movimientos, pedidos=ordenes (already there), equipos=herramientas, principal=dashboard

STEP 2: Create detectarIntencionLocal(texto) function with: navigation patterns (abre/ve a/muestra/ir a + vista), modal patterns (nueva salida/entrada/devolucion, nuevo material/agregar material), confirmation patterns (listo/confirmar/generar/guardar/dale/hazlo/ejecuta), using regex and normTxt
STEP 3: Intercept in recognition.onresult: after stop word check, call detectarIntencionLocal(textoAcumulado). If it returns true, skip enviarTextoAlAgente
STEP 4: Verify syntax with NODE_OPTIONS='' node --check src/renderer/renderer.js
acceptance_criteria: detectarIntencionLocal function exists and handles navigation, modal, and confirmation patterns
Saying 'abre inventario' resolves locally without calling Cloud Function
Saying 'nueva salida' opens modal locally without calling Cloud Function
Saying 'confirmar' or 'listo' calls confirmarModalPorVoz locally when modal is open
Complex commands (stock queries, field filling with data) still go to Cloud Function
findings: Added detectarIntencionLocal() at line 3929. Extended ALIAS_VISTAS with: principal=dashboard, despachos/salidas=movimientos, equipos=herramientas. The function handles 3 categories: (1) navigation via regex matching 'abre/ve a/muestra/ir a' + vista name or alias, plus direct keywords like 'panel general'/'inicio', (2) modal opening via regex 'nueva/generar/crear + salida/entrada/devolucion/material', (3) confirmation via exact word match when estadoAgente is 'en_modal'. Intercepted at line 4092 in recognition.onresult, after stop word check and before enviarTextoAlAgente. File passes node --check. 98 insertions, 2 deletions.
